name: Coin Settle
description: The second clip settles onto the first like a spun coin coming to rest: it starts standing on its edge, then leans over while its lifted side whirls around faster and faster with a sweeping shadow, rocking on its corners in a quickening rattle, until it drops flat and still over the frame. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: whirls
params.description: Number of whirls of the lifted side

params.name: twist
params.description: In-plane turn of the picture when it stands up, undone as it settles

params.name: shading
params.description: Shading of the coin and darkness of its shadow
